spans.s: दृक n. (-कं) A hole. दॄ विदारे कक् ह्रस्वश्च न कित्त्वम् ।

दृकाण m. (-णः) A demigod, presiding over the third part of a sign of
the zodiac, (in Astrology.)

दृक्कर्ण m. (-र्णः) A snake.
 E. दृश् an eye, and कर्ण an ear; whose eyes
are his ears in the opinion of the Hindus, the snake has no visible
external ear.

. Splendor.
 E. दृश् and प्रिय amiable.

दृक्श्रुति m. (-तिः) A snake.
 E. दृश्, and श्रुति the ear; see दृक्कर्ण ।
